entities.summary: Ahmed Sher Khan was an Indian field hockey player who competed in the 1936 Summer Olympics. He was a member of the Indian field hockey team, which won the gold medal. His son Aslam Sher Khan is also a former hockey player who was a part of the gold-winning Indian hockey team at the 1975 World Cup.
